verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document an AI assistant built into MotherDuck's own UI that writes, fixes, or explains SQL. Natural-language analysis runs through the remote and local MCP servers, which are used by the customer's own external AI agent rather than an in-product assistant. Dives turn natural-language prompts into dashboards, which is an adjacent capability and not SQL writing, fixing, or explaining. Instant SQL is a live-preview SQL editor with no AI-assist evidence.
